notes.title: Fixed tower complete achievement
notes.content:
Tower complete achievement was broken :o(
It is now fixed :o)

Following the addition of the Hard versions of the levels the logic for finishing the tower and awarding the achievement had become out dated.

notes.title: Fixed wrecking ball achievement
notes.content: It was no longer possible to get the wrecking ball achievement. The game has been updated to make it possible again.

notes.title: Reduced default quality settings
notes.content: Based on feedback we have reduced the default quality settings to not include volumetric lighting. Automatic configuring of quality didn't manage to correctly set quality on all hardware, potentially leaving it set on a high default. Reducing the default will hopefully help mitigate this issue.

notes.title: Fixed Chinese Language Bug
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the game not automatically switching to Chinese due to a mismatch between what the localisation system expected the language to be called and what the operating system reported. It should now work as expected. 

Language selection now also queries the operating system every time the game launches rather than just the first time it runs. 

[img]https://www.correctuniverse.com/BlocksplodeChinese.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Desert Island Theme Additions
notes.content:
Hey there, demolitionists!

With just under a week to go till release, ride the wave with us as we reveal some brand new background additions to our Desert Island theme!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/927642e26e2e3bd49c7a5c9e93fefb3a3ed4e07e.png[/img]

Keep it cool under the shade of our palm trees as the waves lap against the shore. Even the blue block is having fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/e46f338eda2d0223bde1a91a551b3bec1294fccf.png[/img]

We’ve also added a starfish or two to try and distract you as the puzzles increase in difficulty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/6b2ad7df2926d6c460151f7916ed825c3a368fe2.png[/img]

Also, curious seagulls are soaring through the levels trying to figure out how you can solve the puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/d5da72527240b4ac08572eb065fbf66e683afe31.png[/img]

Wouldn’t you want to explore these islands too? That’s why we added boats that can be seen floating on the crisp blue water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/9a89b17ad9e0cb6c55f0d50cbf8aa96f8605b02a.png[/img]

Tell us what you think of this theme so far by reaching out to us on [url=https://twitter.com/blocksplode]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/Blocksplode-1849766858456639/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/northstarvideogames/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/4AjjVA2Thp]Discord[/url].

Till next time!

notes.title: Work Begins on Desert Islands Theme!
notes.content:
Gather round, explosives experts!

With less than 2 weeks to go till release, we wanted to unveil our brand new theme that we are currently working on behind-the-scenes: Desert Islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/216ed5b669d9a8d2b89cdc61fec2287e36eb8611.png[/img]

This theme will include a brand new land, ocean, shoreline and sky, with the potential for palm trees too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/fc377916a2fddf54c36964e423a12f5c910e18fb.png[/img]

Our aim is to feature this in 15 puzzles and we can’t wait to share more with you as this theme develops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/522e8bb48a714cd979f7c86ba3efde3fa1762b09.png[/img]

Let us know what you think on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and Discord. 

Till next time!

notes.title: Blocksplode Out April 14th, 2021
notes.content:
Ever dreamt of becoming the world’s greatest explosives expert? 

Well, on April 14th, 2021, pick up hilarious physics-based puzzler Blocksplode and find out! 

In Blocksplode, you must blow up block structures, sink the grumpy blue blocks and save the gems in 90+ puzzles to rise to the top of the tower. Enjoy hours of challenging physics-based puzzle solving or create and share online your level designs and puzzles! The game is playable in single-player as well as online multiplayer for up to 4 friends.

Watch our brand new announcement trailer!

Be sure to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/4AjjVA2Thp]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/NorthStarDev]Twitter,[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/northstarvideogames/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Blocksplode-1849766858456639/]Facebook[/url] as we count down to release. 

We look forward to exploding onto Steam on April 14th! 

North Star Games and Infernozzilla

notes.title: Explosive Developer update!
notes.content:
What a blast March has been so far!

We’ve been working on some explosive developments since Blocksplode’s Demo debuted in Steam’s February Games Festival last month and have a lot of exciting news to share with you.

The background graphics have now been reworked with a focus on changing the original floating islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/73f5bed7106bc6f62060305a62839cc15230b910.png[/img]

The background rock geometry and materials have been modified so they now match perfectly with the cleaner look of the blocks and pool area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/dea8d89c77824a3a99eade3f394c20e2cc31664d.png[/img]

We’ve added to the visual interest with the addition of rounded grass mounds, blocky trees, smaller rocks, grass tufts and flowers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/b63daabe471463c4384b57b572e45c84259a5ac1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/1a1ff0e4c31927fb85b5c2d1742dea3318c87576.png[/img]

We’re now eager to start working on a brand new desert island background that will liven up select levels and turn up the heat! Stay tuned…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/a916b05aaebd941d49f0c70f40682460e947d268.png[/img]

Till next time!

Nick

The North Star Games Team

notes.title: Blocksplode Developer Stream & FREE Demo - Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hello there!

We are ecstatic to introduce to the world what we have been working on! A demo of Blocksplode is available for you to try and enjoy during the Steam Game Festival!

Do you need a challenging physics-based game that will awaken the demolition expert in you? Then Blocksplode is the perfect game for you! Try out several levels that will test your puzzle-solving prowess not by putting things back together, but by blowing stuff up into pieces! 

Beautiful graphics, challenging gameplay, and satisfying physics-based puzzles solvable by placing bombs on the right spot, all that fun in one demo!

Also, there will be a live stream with the developers on February 3rd at 2PM US Central Standard Time. On that stream, developers will show off some awesome gameplay, highlight key game features, and answer your questions about Blocksplode!

So be sure to check out Steam store for the stream, download your demo copy, and give Blocksplode a try here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049870/Blocksplode

We also have more stuff planned throughout the festival so stay tuned for more news.
